`bc250-unlock-cores.py` and `LICENSE` are copied without modification.
The containing project's MIT licence is reproduced in `LICENSE`.
The image's separate `bc250-cpu-unlock` wrapper handles hardware detection and
stopping/restoring the governor. There is no automatic CPU unlock service.
